_meta.source: css/rux.css :root and the three [data-theme] blocks; descriptions from @carbon/themes/src/dtcg
_meta.note: usedBy is a grep of the compiled stylesheet for rules naming the token directly. It understates the five contextual ladders, which are flagged `contextual` and carry a curated note on the page instead.

ai-aura-end.description: End color for AI aura gradient effect. Creates a fade-to-transparent effect at the edge of AI-enhanced elements.

ai-aura-hover-background.description: Background color for AI aura on hover. Use when user hovers over AI-enhanced interactive elements.

ai-aura-hover-end.description: End color for AI aura gradient on hover. Creates hover state fade effect for AI elements.

ai-aura-hover-start.description: Start color for AI aura gradient on hover. Provides the vibrant blue beginning of the hover gradient.

ai-aura-start.description: Start color for AI aura gradient effect. Provides the vibrant blue beginning of the gradient for AI-enhanced elements.

ai-border-end.description: End color for AI border gradient. Creates the lighter edge of gradient borders on AI elements.

ai-border-start.description: Start color for AI border gradient. Creates the darker edge of gradient borders on AI elements.

ai-border-strong.description: Strong border color for AI elements. Use for high-emphasis AI borders that need clear definition.

ai-drop-shadow.description: Drop shadow color for AI elements. Provides depth and elevation for AI-enhanced components.

ai-inner-shadow.description: Inner shadow color for AI elements. Creates inset depth effect for AI-enhanced surfaces.

ai-overlay.description: Overlay color for AI modal backgrounds. Use to dim content behind AI dialogs or popovers.

ai-popover-background.description: Background color for AI popovers and tooltips. Provides the base surface for AI-generated content displays.

ai-popover-caret-bottom.description: Bottom caret color for AI popovers. Creates the gradient pointer at the bottom of AI tooltips.

ai-popover-caret-bottom-background-actio.description: AI popover caret bottom background for actions

ai-popover-caret-center.description: Center color for AI popover caret gradient. Creates the vibrant middle of the gradient pointer.

ai-popover-shadow-outer-01.description: Primary outer shadow for AI popovers. Provides the first layer of depth for elevated AI elements.

ai-popover-shadow-outer-02.description: Secondary outer shadow for AI popovers. Adds additional depth layer for AI element elevation.

ai-skeleton-background.description: Background color for AI skeleton loaders. Use while AI-generated content is loading.

ai-skeleton-element-background.description: Element background color for AI skeleton loaders. Provides the animated shimmer effect for loading AI content.

background.description: Default page background color. Use as the base surface for the entire application or page.

background-active.description: Background color for active/pressed state. Use when user clicks or presses interactive elements.

background-brand.description: Brand color for backgrounds. Use for branded sections, headers, or promotional areas.

background-hover.description: Background color for hover state. Use when user hovers over interactive elements to provide visual feedback.

background-inverse.description: Inverse background color for dark UI elements. Use for tooltips, inverse buttons, or dark-themed sections.

background-selected.description: Background color for selected state. Use to highlight currently selected items or active states.

border-disabled.description: Border color for disabled elements. Use when borders need to indicate unavailable or inactive state.

border-interactive.description: Border color for interactive elements. Use for focused inputs, active selections, or clickable borders.

border-inverse.description: Border color for inverse/dark UI elements. Use for borders on dark backgrounds or inverse components.

border-strong-01.description: Strong border color for layer 01. Use for high-contrast borders that need clear definition on first layer.

border-strong-02.description: Strong border color for layer 02. Use for high-contrast borders on second layer surfaces.

border-strong-03.description: Strong border color for layer 03. Use for high-contrast borders on third layer surfaces.

border-subtle-00.description: Subtle border color for base layer. Use for low-contrast borders on page background.

border-subtle-01.description: Subtle border color for layer 01. Use for low-contrast borders on first layer surfaces.

border-subtle-02.description: Subtle border color for layer 02. Use for low-contrast borders on second layer surfaces.

border-subtle-03.description: Subtle border color for layer 03. Use for low-contrast borders on third layer surfaces.

border-subtle-selected-01.description: Subtle border for selected items on layer 01. Use for low-contrast borders on selected elements.

border-subtle-selected-02.description: Subtle border for selected items on layer 02. Use for low-contrast borders on selected elements.

border-subtle-selected-03.description: Subtle border for selected items on layer 03. Use for low-contrast borders on selected elements.

border-tile-01.description: Border color for tiles on layer 01. Use for card or tile borders on first layer.

border-tile-02.description: Border color for tiles on layer 02. Use for card or tile borders on second layer.

border-tile-03.description: Border color for tiles on layer 03. Use for card or tile borders on third layer.

chat-avatar-agent.description: Avatar background color for human agents in chat. Use to distinguish agent messages from bot or user.

chat-avatar-bot.description: Avatar background color for AI bots in chat. Use to identify automated or AI-generated responses.

chat-avatar-user.description: Avatar background color for users in chat. Use to identify messages from the current user.

chat-bubble-agent.description: Background color for agent message bubbles. Use for messages from human agents in chat interfaces.

chat-bubble-border.description: Border color for chat message bubbles. Provides visual definition for all message types.

chat-bubble-user.description: Background color for user message bubbles. Use for messages from the current user in chat interfaces.

chat-button.description: Icon color for chat action buttons. Use for interactive elements within chat interface.

chat-header-background.description: Background color for chat header. Use for the top section of chat interfaces.

chat-header-text.description: Text color for chat header. Ensures readable titles and labels in chat header.

chat-prompt-background.description: Background color for chat input prompt area. Use for the message composition field.

chat-prompt-border-end.description: End color for chat prompt border gradient. Creates fade effect at edge of input area.

chat-prompt-border-start.description: Start color for chat prompt border gradient. Defines the beginning of input border gradient.

chat-prompt-text.description: Text color for chat input prompt. Ensures readable text in message composition area.

chat-shell-background.description: Background color for chat container shell. Use as the base surface for entire chat interface.

field-01.description: Background color for form fields on layer 01. Use for input fields, text areas, and selects on first layer.

field-02.description: Background color for form fields on layer 02. Use for input fields on second layer surfaces.

field-03.description: Background color for form fields on layer 03. Use for input fields on third layer surfaces.

field-hover-01.description: Hover background for fields on layer 01. Use when user hovers over input fields on first layer.

field-hover-02.description: Hover background for fields on layer 02. Use when user hovers over input fields on second layer.

field-hover-03.description: Hover background for fields on layer 03. Use when user hovers over input fields on third layer.

focus.description: Focus indicator color. Use for focus rings and outlines on interactive elements for keyboard navigation.

focus-inset.description: Inset focus indicator color. Use for inner focus rings on elements with colored backgrounds.

focus-inverse.description: Focus indicator for inverse/dark elements. Use for focus rings on dark backgrounds.

highlight.description: Highlight color for selected text or emphasized content. Use for text selection or search result highlighting.

icon-disabled.description: Icon color for disabled state. Use when icons need to indicate unavailable or inactive functionality.

icon-interactive.description: Icon color for interactive elements. Use for clickable icons, buttons, and actionable items.

icon-inverse.description: Icon color for inverse/dark backgrounds. Use for icons on dark surfaces or inverse components.

icon-on-color.description: Icon color for colored backgrounds. Use for icons on brand colors, buttons, or colored surfaces.

icon-on-color-disabled.description: Disabled icon color on colored backgrounds. Use when icons on colored surfaces are inactive.

icon-primary.description: Primary icon color. Use for main icons with highest visual priority and emphasis.

icon-secondary.description: Secondary icon color. Use for supporting icons with less emphasis than primary.

interactive.description: Interactive element color. Use for clickable elements, links, and actionable items.

link-inverse.description: Link color for dark backgrounds. Use for links on inverse or dark surfaces.

link-primary.description: Primary link color. Use for standard hyperlinks and navigation links.

link-secondary.description: Secondary link color. Use for less prominent links or alternative link styles.

link-visited.description: Color for visited links. Use to indicate previously clicked links.

overlay.description: Overlay color for modal backgrounds. Use to dim content behind dialogs and modals.

shadow.description: Shadow color for elevation. Provides depth and layering for elevated components.

skeleton-background.description: Background color for skeleton loaders. Use as base for loading placeholders.

skeleton-element.description: Element color for skeleton loaders. Provides the animated shimmer effect for loading states.

support-caution-major.description: Major caution color. Use for high-severity warnings or significant issues.

support-caution-minor.description: Minor caution color. Use for low-severity warnings or minor issues.

support-caution-undefined.description: Undefined caution color. Use for unknown or indeterminate caution states.

support-error.description: Error color for critical states. Use for error messages, failed validations, and critical alerts.

support-info.description: Info color for informational states. Use for helpful tips, neutral information, and guidance.

support-success.description: Success color for positive states. Use for success messages, completed actions, and confirmations.

support-warning.description: Warning color for caution states. Use for warnings, potential issues, and items needing attention.

syntax-block-comment.description: Syntax highlighting color for block comments. Use for multi-line comment blocks.

syntax-comment.description: Syntax highlighting color for comments. Use for all comment types in code editors.

syntax-control-keyword.description: Syntax highlighting color for control flow keywords. Use for if, else, while, return.

syntax-definition-keyword.description: Syntax highlighting color for definition keywords. Use for def, function, class declarations.

syntax-doc-comment.description: Syntax highlighting color for documentation comments. Use for JSDoc, docstrings, etc.

syntax-doc-string.description: Syntax highlighting color for documentation strings. Use for docstring literals.

syntax-keyword.description: Syntax highlighting color for keywords. Use for language keywords like if, for, class.

syntax-line-comment.description: Syntax highlighting color for line comments. Use for single-line comments in code.

syntax-module-keyword.description: Syntax highlighting color for module keywords. Use for import, export, require.

syntax-operator-keyword.description: Syntax highlighting color for operator keywords. Use for keywords like and, or, not.

syntax-string.description: Syntax highlighting color for strings. Use for string literals in code.

syntax-variable.description: Syntax highlighting color for variables. Use for variable names and identifiers.
